tflac_u32 max_size_frame(tflac_u32 blocksize, tflac_u32 channels, tflac_u32 bitdepth) {
    return 18U + channels +
           (((blocksize * bitdepth * (channels * (channels != 2))) +
             (blocksize * bitdepth * (channels == 2)) +
             (blocksize * (bitdepth + (bitdepth != 32)) * (channels == 2)) +
             +7) /

}
